recommendation.minimum_next_step: Prepare a bounded data-contract and family-review draft for at most 12 initial annotated events after two genuinely new task mechanisms pass family/semantics/split gates. No generation or model call is performed or authorized by this review itself.
required_content: Contrast cases where identical current parameters differ only by relevant prior successful effect; explicit target-event scope and cumulative count.
Contrast actual purchased entity with cheaper unchosen alternative, and successful-but-disqualified vs successful-qualified prerequisites.
Include authorized technical nonexecution and ambiguous partial-effect cases, with execution and permission labeled independently.
Targets contain event identity, minimal sufficient condition(s), correct source/field and temporal links, concise justification and adjudicated uncertainty, not unconstrained teacher reasoning.
data_constraints: The present 16 scripted cases and all 20 natural trajectories remain development; none become training/validation/test by renaming, new seed, different person or amount.
New mechanism families must be reviewed before generation and preassigned train/validation roles. Final unseen bank/airline families must remain outside design/tuning review.
For the first bounded annotation sample, separately review labels and evidence relations; resolve disagreements without treating this same reviewer/design-owner chain as independent human agreement.
Only if grounded residual semantic errors repeat on accepted new-family data should a separately budgeted LoRA feasibility/gradient precheck be considered.
recommendation.why_not_more_prompt_chasing: The decisive failures persist despite complete visible inputs and supplied execution facts. Copy/format repair alone cannot determine the correct prior event, purchased flight, or target-specific authorization condition.
